hero.title: A quieter
hero.description: Drawn in São Paulo studios — a men's frame designed to be forgotten on the face and remembered by the eyes.

features.title: Considered proportion
features.body: A quieter silhouette — narrower, lower, drawn to disappear rather than announce.

features.title: Screen-honest color
features.body: EyegisGuard™ filters the harmful HEV band without an amber tint or color shift.

features.title: Weightless on the bridge
features.body: 17.8g of hand-polished acetate with titanium-core hinges tuned for zero pressure.

detail.title: Thin temples,
detail.body: Every line is functional. Titanium-core hinges disappear into the acetate. No ornament, no logo screaming across the temple — just a quiet, considered profile.

box.title: Men's Collection, carefully packed.
box.packageCaption: Recyclable paperboard box · debossed Eyegis mark
box.pouchCaption: Microfibre pouch · doubles as a lens cloth

lifestyle.title: Studios, long deep work, unhurried thinking.
